_meta.how: one `capture noisily twoway ...` per probe; first = the first non-blank output line; a probe with a reference is drawn under `set seed 1`, exported as SVG and its md5 (random clip-path names made one) compared with the reference's
_meta.purpose: twoway's rc and first line for the option values dash refused in its own words (basic:PT-9), and twoway's drawing of the values dash's own bounds refused (basic:PT-13). Read by scripts/gen_value_refusal_table.py and the Q3505 cases.
